piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 ↔ RHW-4 L0 — Mirrored Diagonal Ramp — Opposite Upper Descent — Alignment A.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 ↔ RHW-4 L0 — Mirrored Diagonal Ramp — Opposite Upper Descent — Alignment A
piece.description: A diagonal paired ramp converts the stacked L1/L2 DD RHW-4 into two ground RHW-4 carriageways. It preserves two lanes per direction, the selected upper-road side and traffic phase, driver-left yellow markings, and explicitly measured first-cut native sockets.

engineering.source_scope: Reviewed Alignment A source05 encoded physical geometry and ownership; normal DAT verification, installation, and game observations are separate gates
engineering.station_sampling: 0.125m source grid plus exact profile breaks and lane-dependent cut endpoints
engineering.height_integration: Adaptive Simpson per smooth interval, absolute target2e-12, depth20
engineering.cell_transform_policy: Fresh city-grid clipping and native reconstruction per variant; no reflected-mask equivalence
engineering.middle_body_floor_policy: Native309 datum faded with PATH height; one metre below roof, clamped to ground
engineering.native_shoulder_depth_policy: Reviewed first-A finite 302/309 profiles and source-only original native union; every authored floor and wall is retained, and no old exception is inherited

support_plan.scope: Fourteen complete diagonal support solids independently checked in source05 for closed faces, contact, and full clearance; normal DAT and game checks are separate
support_plan.cap_contact: Flat cap centre meets the served underside; finite own-slab embedding is checked from actual meshes

physical_source_review.scope: Independent ordered physical checks of all four choices and 196 actual encoded source payloads; no game acceptance

engineering.ownership_scope: Reviewed source05 mask: 24 owned cells, 15 routed and nine model-only, with 39 terrain corners; actual native collars, source-parent shoulder hosting, and complete supports checked while all native approach corridors remain unowned

provenance.geometry: Measured diagonal DD and ground RHW-4 native interfaces, an independently reviewed sparse mask, four same-lane journeys, and curve-aware height profiles. No orthogonal profile or reflected cell mask substitutes for actual diagonal measurements.
provenance.construction: Explicit flat constraints on every reviewed owned cell; three unowned native sockets with their separately audited finite peers; four proper rotations repeated across eight cursor states.
provenance.granularity: One independently useful coordinated DD-to-ground conversion per side/traffic choice. Interior slope and curve sections do not expose a proven standard native connection for an arbitrary split.
provenance.alignment: First explicit longitudinal native mouth cut only. The adjacent 302/309 cut is not supplied by four rotations or inferred from the parallel transverse spacing.

connections.purpose: Intrinsic saved-resource endpoints, service roles, directed journeys, and forbidden transfers for one piece.

source.scope: one piece only; no counterpart catalogue is consulted
source.construction_basis: Actual emitted per-piece rule sections from the independently verified saved build
